definitions.short: to breathe after , i.e. to love (sensually)
definitions.full: H5689. agab [ עָגַב ] verb have inordinate affection, lust (compare Arabic wonder, admire , beloved ; and (on sens. obsc. in Late Hebrew) Levy NHWB iii. 616 ); — Qal Perfect 3feminine singular עָֽגְבָה Ezek 23:7 , 9 , 12 ; Imperfect 3feminine singular וַתַּעְגַּב 23:5 , + 23:16 Kt (Qr וַתַּעְגְּבָה ), וַתַּעְגְּבָּה 23:20 (Ew § 191 c Ol § 228 b ); Participle plural עֹגְבִים Jer 4:30 ; — lust after ( עַלֿ ), only in figure of relations of Samaria and Jerusalem (personified) with foreigners Ezek 23:5 , 9 , 12 , 16 , 20 , so with accusative 23:7 ; participle as substantive paramours Jer 4:30 .
